title: Dub sync report (per-project, per-language blocks)
description: Measures how well each dub track's synthesized audio fits the caption timing that is the downstream contract. One file per project at audio/sync-report.json; each active dub-enabled language contributes a block. Per-cue drift (ms) is rendered-vs-caption timing; stretch_factor is synthesized/target duration (>1 = compressed to fit). Cumulative offset is reset to 0 at natural pauses so a single long cue cannot poison the whole track. The aggregate `audio-sync` gate report (review.schema.json) is derived from this file.

quality_bars.description: Snapshot of the company audio quality bars used to measure this report.

languages.description: Map of ISO 639-1 language -> that track's sync measurements.

provider.description: TTS provider that produced the dub, or 'imported'.

dub_path.description: Project-relative path to the rendered dub WAV.

cumulative_offset_ms.description: Final cumulative drift after natural-pause resets.

cues_over_tolerance.description: Cue ids whose |drift| exceeds per-cue tolerance.

cues_over_stretch_cap.description: Cue ids whose fit demanded a stretch beyond the cap (clamped, not forced).

stretch_factor.description: Synthesized duration / target duration before fitting (1.0 = perfect fit).

reset_here.description: Cumulative offset was reset to 0 at this cue's natural pause.
